found.name: Hope’s Generative AI Guidance document
found.quote: Hope’s Generative AI Guidance document outlines how GenAI can be used to support your learning, and how GenAI should and should not be used. There are also some tips to help you.

found.name: Referencing Generative AI (GenAI) sources in your work guide
found.quote: The Library team has produced a Referencing Generative AI (GenAI) sources in your work guide, which highlights how to reference using the referencing styles in use across the University.
found.anchor: Acknowledging and referencing use of GenAI

found.name: Studiosity
found.quote: Studiosity provides 24/7 writing support including feedback on a piece of writing. Information about this resource and it’s availability can be found on the Study Skills Moodle.

found.name: Research Assistant on OneSearch
found.quote: Research Assistant is only accessing reliable academic resources such as journal articles and textbooks. Watch this short video to find out how to use OneSearch.
